sentences.en: Make one more effort and you will reach the summit.
sentences.zh: 再加把劲儿，你就能到达山顶了。

sentences.en: The summit of the mountain is covered with fresh snow.
sentences.zh: 山顶覆盖着新鲜的积雪。

sentences.en: When I reached the summit, I was thoroughly worn out.

senses.zh: （政府间的）首脑会议，峰会；山顶，顶峰；（成就的）顶点，最高点；最高阶层
